trickyParts: release() is idempotent via a `released` flag: index.ts releases through stop() on a failed boot probe and again in startDaemon's catch; a bare second closeSync would throw EBADF (or close a reused descriptor number).

O_CLOEXEC is the numeric per-platform constant (Linux 0o2000000, Darwin 0x1000000): fs.constants.O_CLOEXEC is undefined under Bun 1.3.14 and Bun's openSync does not set it; the no-inherit test asserts the bit via /proc/self/fdinfo on Linux.
errno is read immediately after the failed flock, before closeSync, via __errno_location through bun:ffi; a losing contender closes its descriptor before the bounded pid re-read (20 x 25 ms).
